title: Temper claims about tested components and mechanical assessment
requirements:
- Replace the 'arrive tested' wording with a statement that reusable test specifications and evidence reduce but do not replace local verification
- Replace 'fall out mechanically' and similar wording with a statement of what can be automated and what needs expert judgement
- Frame the ArchiMate-typed conformance model as a reference model; allow other ecosystems that map to it
- Require evidence to be checked against selected version, options, configuration and national profile
- Qualify ArchiMate-based checkability claims in 3.1 as dependent on conventions, validation rules and governance
- Present IHE as a leading worked example and explain how FHIR IGs, SMART Guidelines, DICOM and national profiles fit
- State that country-specific supplementary testing (terminology, security, performance, deployment) remains necessary
- Say who performs assessments and how disputes over conformance claims are resolved; cross-reference 3.1 to 3.7 rules
